# Fields on bulk-generated greenfield resources that are accepted as not
# exercised by any test fixture.
#
# This is the escape hatch for TestGreenfieldBulkFieldCoverage
# (GREENFIELD_STRICT=1). It is NOT for "not done yet" - fields awaiting fixture
# coverage should simply stay in alpha-missingfields.txt and be fixed. Use this
# only when a field genuinely cannot be exercised, and say why.
#
# Format, mirroring refs_not_representable.txt:
#
#   [accepted] crd=<crd-name> version=v1alpha1: field ".spec.foo" reason=<why>
#
# A reason= token is mandatory; entries without one fail the test.
#
# SANDBOX-ONLY. Not upstream policy.
